players.name: Jeffers/Basallo
players.summary: Rookie C/DH Samuel Basallo continues to hit (multiple HRs in June, including June 12 vs San Diego), splitting catching duties with Adley Rutschman and DHing often.

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper added a sac-fly RBI in a 7-0 shutout of the Marlins on June 15; hitting in the middle of the Phillies order.

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez remains among the NL contact leaders for San Francisco, hitting around .320 as the Giants' table-setter.

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette had 3 of the Mets' 6 hits in a 12-0 loss at Cincinnati on June 15; a bright spot in a quiet stretch.

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Rookie Kevin McGonigle homered June 15 at Houston and has reached base in 24 straight games — an All-Star-caliber start for Detroit.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: Crow-Armstrong hit for the cycle June 15 — MLB's first of 2026 — in a 5-4 walk-off win over the Rockies; slashing .277 with 13 HR and 16 SB.

sources.title: PCA hits for cycle as Cubs walk off Rockies - Washington Post

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill returned to the lineup June 15 after a one-game rib scare (MRI/CT negative), going 0-for-4 but robbing a home run in a 3-0 loss to St. Louis.

sources.title: Jackson Merrill returns to Padres' lineup - MLB.com

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Hernández remains on the IL (since May 27) with a Grade 1 left hamstring strain; the Dodgers are taking a measured approach to his return.

sources.title: Teoscar Hernández expected to miss 1 month - Yahoo Sports

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams (Mets closer) has settled in after a rough April, stringing together scoreless outings; 10 saves on the year.

sources.title: Mets' Devin Williams finding his groove - MLB.com

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler dominated June 15 — 6 scoreless 2-hit innings, 9 K — lowering his ERA to 2.01; among the NL's best despite a late start to 2026.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans had a mid-June rehab setback (elbow stiffness) and was sent for further testing; on the IL since May 8 with no return timeline.

sources.title: Royals' Ragans has setback in rehab - ESPN

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns extended a historic rookie run June 15 — 5 scoreless innings, 7 K in a 12-0 win — his 11th straight start allowing 2 or fewer runs.

sources.title: Chase Burns' dominance among greatest Reds stretches - SI

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi earned the win June 14 at Boston (7 IP, 3 ER); the 36-year-old is healthy after a mid-May side-tightness scare.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan remains in the Dodgers' rotation despite an up-and-down 4.76 ERA; home runs have been the recurring issue, but he's healthy.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers owns strong peripherals (97 K over 81 IP, ~29% K-rate) though his 2-win record lags; healthy and entrenched in the Angels rotation.

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice is in a full breakout for the Yankees (~.300, 1.000+ OPS, ~19 HR), hitting cleanup amid Aaron Judge's absence; HR June 14 at Toronto.

sources.title: From Ivy League catcher to Yankees' cleanup hitter - ESPN

injuries.name: Teoscar Hernandez
injuries.note: Grade 1 left hamstring strain; on IL since May 27, expected ~1 month out with a cautious return timeline.

source.title: Teoscar Hernández expected to miss 1 month - Yahoo Sports

injuries.name: Cole Ragans
injuries.note: Mid-June rehab setback with elbow stiffness; undergoing further testing, no return timeline. On IL since May 8.

source.title: Royals' Ragans has setback in rehab - ESPN

injuries.name: Jackson Merrill
injuries.note: Returned June 15 after one game out; MRI and CT scan came back negative.

source.title: Jackson Merrill returns to Padres' lineup - MLB.com
